name: docs-deployment-docker-md-00
yaml:
# docker-compose.yml
services:
  rift:
    image: zainalpour/rift-proxy:latest
    container_name: rift
    ports:
      - "2525:2525"    # Admin API
      - "4545:4545"    # Imposter port
      - "9090:9090"    # Metrics
    environment:
      - MB_PORT=2525
      - MB_ALLOW_INJECTION=true
      - MB_LOGLEVEL=info
    volumes:
      - ./imposters.json:/imposters.json:ro
    command: ["--configfile", "/imposters.json"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rift", "healthcheck"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
